messages:
julia: flagging a weird one: TypeScript users report vscode can't find typings for `import {Client} from 'redwood-sdk'` even though types are published.
rahul: what package version and what does package.json point to for types?
julia: v6.3.0. package.json has "types": "dist/index.d.ts" and exports: { "./*": { "import": "./esm/*.mjs", "default": "./cjs/*.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }
ivy: does the consumer use moduleResolution: node or bundler?
julia: bundler (vite) with tsconfig moduleResolution set to "bundler". tsc/tsserver fails to resolve to dist/index.d.ts. it looks like the editor follows the exports map and tries to locate a matching subpath, then gives up.
rahul: ah, tsserver relies on exports mapping for module resolution in recent TS versions. if top-level package exports don't include an explicit entry for "." or for the bare import, TS might not locate types unless there's a matching entry.
sylvia: we intentionally used wildcard subpaths to map internal files for tree-shaking, but we probably forgot to add an explicit top-level export mapping that points to typings for ESM/CJS.
julia: repro: create new vite+ts app, `import {Client} from 'redwood-sdk'` -> hover shows "Could not find a declaration file for module 'redwood-sdk'". `node -e "require('redwood-sdk')"` works at runtime (on node16), but TS is unhappy.
ivy: quick fixes: 1) add an explicit exports entry for ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./esm/index.mjs", "default": "./cjs/index.cjs" } or 2) add a "typesVersions" map to guide TS to dist types for all module targets.
rahul: also ensure "./package.json" remains in exports so bundlers can read the package metadata. Some bundlers read package.json to find types.
sylvia: for a short-term patch we should: A) add explicit top-level export for bare import B) set "types" to "dist/index.d.ts" (already set) but duplicate via exports types entry C) add a tiny TS smoke test in our sample-suite (vite+ts) to catch regressions.
julia: customer is blocked for onboarding sample. I'll reply with workaround: pin to v6.2.x or add `resolve.alias` in vite to map 'redwood-sdk' -> 'redwood-sdk/dist/index.d.ts' (ugly).
ivy: long-term: update packaging docs to include a recommended exports + types pattern for libraries that ship both ESM/CJS + TS types. maybe include a template package.json snippet in our devex docs.
rahul: create PR to: add "." export entry with types and require fields, add typesVersions, and add vite+ts smoke-test to CI. Also add changelog note about exportmap->TS resolution.
doc-bot: Issue created: redwood/devex#900 - add exports/types compatibility patch + TS smoke tests.
sylvia: also add a short note in SDK migration guide: "if you see missing typings after upgrading, check package exports and use TS moduleResolution bundler or bump to TS 4.7+."
julia: thanks all. I'll update the ticket with the repro steps and link to the PR once it's open.
rahul: assigning to me to prepare the patch. aiming for patch release today.
doc-bot: CI flagged failing sample-suite vite-ts-smoke on main - failing reproducer present.
julia: closing loop for now.
